title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. translated_title: 用于智能体评估中可控用户模拟的三层人格向量
translated_abstract: 评估工具增强型大语言模型（LLM）智能体需要多样化且真实的用户输入，然而大多数评估框架使用扁平化的角色描述（如“你是一位愤怒的客户”），无论底层场景如何都会产生近乎相同的对话。在本文中，我们提出了一种包含23个可操作化维度的三层人格向量：6个分类人口统计属性（司法管辖区、年龄、渠道、设备、语言熟练度、时间可用性）、12个连续行为特征（耐心、果断性、数字素养等），这些特征围绕精选的档案基础向量以高斯噪声进行采样；以及5个连续情绪状态（挫败感、焦虑、信任、自信、压力），这些状态会随场景情境而动态变化。与人格维度正交的是，一个4级查询复杂度叠加层可控制话语的表达方式，从直接到刻意模糊。我们在一个合成数据生成流水线中对该人格模型进行了评估，涵盖64,698个多轮对话……
tldr: 提出了一种包含23个维度的三层人格向量模型（分类人口统计、连续行为特征、动态情绪状态），并结合与人格正交的4级查询复杂度控制，实现了智能体评估中多样化且可控的合成用户模拟。
en_tdlr: Proposes a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions (categorical demographics, continuous behavioral traits, and dynamic emotional states) combined with an orthogonal 4-level query-complexity overlay to enable diverse and controllable synthetic user simulation for agentic evaluation.
